title: Chapter 334
text:
Ordnance Engineer lvl 1. + 1 END, + 3 INT, + 1.5% Machinery Affinity, + 2 Free Attribute Points, + 1 Potential Point

You have learned the War Machinery Essence ability.

You have learned Rapid Ordnance Maintenance.

There would be a chain reaction between the Ordnance Engineer class and the Mechanic class. The Ordnance Engineer's skills and attributes were very compatible with the Mechanic class, and it was almost equivalent to half of the main class. (Updated at the earliest):

。

As the name suggested, the Siege Lion was an Intelligence class. It did not have any combat skills, but it was more useful for Mechanics than combat skills. Ordnance referred to war machines, such as guns, armor, shields, and so on. This subclass would have additional enhancements when creating and using war machines.

Han Xiao had piles of experience in his waist. With a wave of his hand, he directly leveled up the two skills to the maximum level.

[War Machine Mastery LV10: Gain an additional 18% Attack and Defense when using war machines.]

Quick Ordnance Maintenance LVL 10: + 24% Speed when repairing war machines. Randomly restores 3-6% Durability during the repair process. Triggering rate depends on INT. Unlimited number of times.

The effects of these two skills were simple and crude, but they were quite useful to Han Technician. However, the main reason he had obtained this subclass was to obtain the ability after reaching the maximum level.

He 'spent' more than 90 million EXP to level up his subclass to the maximum level.

This subclass gave him a total of 10 END, 30 INT, 15% Machinery Affinity, 20 Free Attribute Points, and 10 Potential Points. If his new skills were maxed out, he would have a few more Potential Points. (Latest update)

Han Xiao's Intelligence attribute had reached 391. He put all of his free attribute points into Intelligence and broke through the 400 mark required for class advancement.

The Ordnance Engineer was now at max level. Just like the Night Stalker, a new ability had appeared.

You have learned Militarized Modification.

You have received the talent – Ordnance Mass Production.

Military Modification LV10: When creating or modifying combat machines, + 8% ~ 14% to the equipment base attribute. (Note: This bonus is calculated separately and has nothing to do with strengthening and modification.)

"This is equivalent to an additional enhancement enhancement. It's pretty decent." Han Xiao nodded and looked at the newly obtained specialty. This was what he valued the most.

Mass production bonus, this was the essence of this subclass!

There were a few signs of a Mechanic's growth, and high-speed assembly during battle was one of them. It was one of the reasons for the rise of the Mechanic class in Version 3.0. Assembly line mass production was a sign of the later stages. Mass production was a necessary ability of the Mechanic class's most violent and most expensive fighting style, 'Army Style' and 'Storm Style'.

Normal Mechanics used high-quality weapons that were strengthened by 'essence', and mass-produced weapons were 'consumables' of lower quality. As mechanical technology improved, the gap between different quality would become bigger and bigger. However, quantitative changes could accumulate into qualitative changes, and those scattered bonuses would result in a world of difference through mass production. (Author's note: This is the first time that a Mechanic class has been upgraded.)

The Mechanic class and the Mage class were two classes that had very high benefits in the later stages of the game. The Mechanical Army Style and the Magic Summoning Style could turn a duel into a group fight, which was extremely disgusting. Almost all players could not withstand the waves of rush from these two combat styles, and their gaming experience was extremely bad.

However, although these two styles were strong, they had a huge limitation, and the reason was obvious — they were very expensive! Mass-Producing a Mech Legion was extremely expensive for the players. Furthermore, at that time, all the players' individual combat ability would be strong enough. Even if the Army Style could overwhelm the opponent with a sea of players, their own army would be greatly depleted. If they participated in the Pro League, the Army Style's combat ability would be in a constant state of decline. The Army Style that had accumulated for an entire season would be depleted after ten or twenty matches.

If the Army Style clashed with the Army Style, oh wow, that would be so cool. A group battle would be a grand spectacle, and the spectators would be happy. However, both sides would be completely wiped out, and not a single strand of hair would be left.

Therefore, in Han Xiao's previous life, the Army Style and the Storm Style were known as' legendary 'styles, and they were extremely rare. If one saw such players, they would definitely cherish them. After all, they could betray the sect at any time …

Han Xiao had analyzed the situation. The players were relatively weak now, and he could personally trample on them. However, in the later stages, the players would become more and more powerful, and he did not want to take too many risks. Therefore, developing the Army Style was a necessary choice, even if it was just a trump card.

What, the Army Style is very expensive?

In the eyes of the Han Technician, a problem that could be solved with money was not a problem at all!

This was especially so when this talent could even reduce the cost. Seeing these words, Han Xiao felt as if he had drunk a cup of hot water. His entire body was comfortable and nourished, and all kinds of illnesses could be cured.

Han Xiao had a more long-term plan for his growth. Although he had not learned the assembly line knowledge yet, he wanted to obtain a useful talent first.

His total level was 80, and he had also met the requirements for class advancement. The level 80 class advancement mission required him to sacrifice 60,000,000 EXP. It was simple and straightforward. Han Xiao could not help but feel relieved. The random class advancement mission this time was considered very easy.

In Version 2.0, the level cap was 90, and in Version 1.0, the level cap was 60. Players did not know about class advancement missions in Version 1.0 because they could not level up. This meant that players had to undergo two class advancement missions in Version 2.0: level 60 and level 80. The level 60 class advancement was the key dividing line for Race Evolution, so the level 80 class advancement was relatively easier.

However, the so-called 'simple' was only according to the standards of the Han Technician. If players wanted to accumulate 60,000,000 EXP, they would need to spend a very long time. He had only spent 90,000,000 EXP to level up from 70 to 80. Players were not as rich as the Han Technician, so they could only slowly grind their way up level by level. One could imagine the significance of this amount to them.

Furthermore, sacrificing this amount of EXP was equivalent to not gaining anything. This kind of class advancement requirement would make players very blue.

Han Xiaoxin was very happy. Now, there are only two class advancement missions left. As long as I earn enough money from this mission, I can go back home and get married … Pfft, I can go back and change my class to my new main class!

After leaving the bar, Han Xiao and Lerden strolled on the streets of Forest City.

The sky was filled with thousands of stars, and the soft starlight fell on their shoulders. Although the environment of this planet was dangerous, the scenery was very beautiful.

The green mountains in the distance, the verdant forests, the rustling of leaves in the wind that seemed to have been dyed in green, and the resplendent galaxy that hung upside down above his head. Back then, the Sunil refugees had been moved to this planet by Godora probably because they had taken a fancy to the natural environment here.

Han Xiao shook his head. He could not help but think of a famous quote from Lu Xun. Dangerous things often have beautiful appearances.

"Where else are you going?" Lerden asked.

"Just walking around."

"Then let's leave the city and return to the base."

"Don't you have anywhere to go in the city?" Han Xiao asked.

Lerden shook his head. "I don't have a family."

Han Xiao stroked his chin and asked, "What mission do you have?"

"Field combat."

"This is the most dangerous job. You Sunil Supers hand over the hard-earned money and even risk your life to carry out dangerous missions. Such dedication, as expected of a hero of the race."

Lerden had a complicated look in his eyes. He wanted to say something but stopped. In the end, he shook his head and did not say anything.

This expression was seen by Han Xiao, and he was secretly overjoyed. He had obtained the information he wanted from the test.

If I'm not wrong, the Sunil storyline already exists … Han Xiao narrowed his eyes.
